commands.title: Proje değişiklikleri
commands.summary: Bir bulut projesine nesne ekler, değiştirir, siler ve proje bilgisini günceller; hepsi tek işlemde yazılır ya da hiçbiri yazılmaz. Her değişen nesnenin ve proje bilgisinin beklenen sürümü zarfın expectedVersions alanındadır; biri değişmişse 409 döner, hiçbir şey yazılmaz. Nesneler feature.write, proje bilgisi project.edit ister. Aynı idempotency anahtarıyla tekrar aynı sonucu verir.

AnnotationHeights.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper, mm (docs/adr/0205 §1): a
height not given is its kind's default.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:

(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

AuthKind.description: The proof a service asks for (docs/adr/0208 §12).

HTTP Basic: a user name and a password.
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

BlockChange.description:
A change of one block definition. An update replaces it whole and a
delete removes it, each guarded by `expectedVersions["block:<id>"]`.

oneOf.description: A new definition; its id is the client's, as an object's.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it; their layer is kept, but an
insert draws them on its own layer (the DXF's layer 0), each with its own
colour or line weight when it has one.

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

name.description: Unique in the drawing, Turkish case folded.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in

Convention.description:
Which way a Helmert transformation's rotations turn: EPSG's position
vector convention (9606) or its coordinate frame convention (9607).

CrsBase.description:
A local system's base: a projected system of the registry by its EPSG
code (`srid`), or a transverse Mercator the project defines
(`definition`); exactly one.

CrsDefinition.description:
A coordinate system the project defines (docs/adr/0168 §1): its name
and what it is.

CrsPlane.description:
A local system's coordinates to its base's: base x = a·x + b·y + c,
base y = d·x + e·y + f; a similarity turns counter-clockwise (degrees),
scales, then shifts.

CrsSystem.description: The kind of system a definition is.

CustomDatum.description:
A datum the project defines: its ellipsoid and, when it has one, its
seven parameters to WGS 84 (without them it stands alone).

DatumTransform.description:
The project's choice for a pair of the registry's datums instead of
EPSG's way (docs/adr/0168 §3); the pair's other way is its reverse. It
shifts by seven parameters (`helmert`) or an NTv2 grid (`grid`); exactly
one.

name.description: What the values rest on: “ED50 → TUREF: Bölge 7”.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

arrow.description: Its arrowheads; absent: oblique ticks.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,
`DEFAULT_ARROW` for the others.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

c.description:
Angular: the vertex. Arc length: the arc's centre. Jogged: the centre
the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

decimals.description:
A length's, a coordinate's or a slope's decimals; absent: the
project's length decimals (a slope's 2). Angles keep the project's.

dimLineColor.description:
The dimension line's and its arrowheads' colour, `#RRGGBB`; absent:
the object's (docs/adr/0205 §6).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extColor.description: The extension lines' colour; absent: the object's.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a
text's mask, docs/adr/0145).

prefix.description: Written before the value (and its kind's own prefix).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textColor.description: The value's colour; absent: the object's.

textGap.description: The value's baseline over the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_TEXT_GAP`.

textPlace.description: Where the value stands; absent: over the line.

unit.description: The unit lengths and coordinates are written in; absent: the project's.

za.description: Slope: the two points' elevations, metres (docs/adr/0147).

DimensionStyle.description:
A dimension's kind (none: aligned). The last five came with KCAD schema 9
(docs/adr/0147): what `a`, `b`, `c`, `offset`, `angle`, `za` and `zb`
mean for each is the ADR's table.

oneOf.description: Koordinat: the point's Y (`angle` 0) or X (`angle` 90).
Yay uzunluğu: the arc about `c` from `a` to `b`, counter-clockwise.
Kırıklı yarıçap: the radius about `a` through `b`, drawn from `c`.
Semt: the direction from `a` to `b`, from north clockwise.
Eğim: the slope between `a` at `za` and `b` at `zb`.

DimensionStyleDef.description: A named dimension style (docs/adr/0183 §3): sizes in paper mm.

arrowSize.description: The arrowhead's length, mm; absent: the arrowhead's default times the height.

dimLineColor.description: The line fields as a dimension's (docs/adr/0205 §6); weights in paper mm.

height.description: The value's height on paper, mm.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's dimension styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description: As a text style's.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

EllipseEntity.description: DXF ELLIPSE: centre, major axis vector, minor/major ratio, parameters t0 → t1.

oneOf.description: A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144).

Rows and columns of cells (docs/adr/0184).
A picture (docs/adr/0192).
An orthophoto, a scanned sheet or an elevation model (docs/adr/0204).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

The objects a hatch made inside a closed object follows (docs/adr/0186

HatchGradient.description: A gradient: its shape, whether it runs the other way, its second colour.

Degrees, counter-clockwise from east: the lines' (lines, cross), the
pattern's turn (pattern), the gradient's direction (gradient).

gradient.description: A gradient's shape and second colour.

User-defined lines and the same turned 90°.
A pattern of line families (`name`, `scale`, `lines`).

Helmert.description:
Seven parameters: translations (m), rotations (″) in their convention,
the scale difference (ppm), and the accuracy (m) when it is given.

asset.description:
The project library's PNG or JPEG asset its bytes are (embedded);

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's

object (docs/adr/0139).

mirror.description: The picture mirrored in its own x axis (Aynala), before the turn.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

InsertEntity.description:
A block placed in the drawing (docs/adr/0144): its definition drawn
moved from the definition's base point to `p`, mirrored in the
definition's x axis when `mirror`, then scaled and turned about `p`. The
transform is a similarity: shapes keep their kind. The insert's own
attributes carry the values of the definition's attribute definitions.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mirror.description: Mirrored in the definition's x axis, before the turn.

p.description: Where the definition's base point goes.

scale.description: Positive and finite; 1 is the definition's size.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

JunctionLayer.description: A junction layer: its points' role and, optionally, which of them it takes and which are closed.

closed.description: An expression: the junctions it holds for (a closed valve) are passed by no analysis.

oneOf.description: Bağlantı: splits the edges it lies on.
Kaynak: where the supply comes from (Yalıtım's beslemesiz kalan).
Vana: where Yalıtım stops.

LabelStyle.description: How entity labels on a layer are drawn; sizes in CSS px.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerState.description:
A named layer state (docs/adr/0177 §4; QGIS's map themes, AutoCAD's
layer states): the tree's nodes as they were when it was saved, their
visibility and, when it was saved with them, their locks and the layers'
styles. The project keeps them (`ProjectSettings::layer_states`).

id.description: One of its kind among the project's states.

name.description:
Its name as the menu lists it: not empty, one of its kind (as written,
spaces at its ends aside).

nodes.description: The nodes, in the tree's order when it was saved.

LayerStateNode.description: A node of a layer state: a layer's or a group's id and what was kept of it.

locked.description: Its own lock, when the state keeps locks.

node.description: The node's id; a node the tree no longer has is passed over.

style.description: A layer's style, when the state keeps styles; a group has none.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LeaderArrow.description:
A leader's arrowhead other than the filled triangle (Dolu üçgen,
AutoCAD's Closed filled), which is no value but the field's absence: a
leader has one spelling (docs/adr/0146 §1). The first three are the
first leaders'; the others AutoCAD's arrowheads (docs/adr/0205 §7, `.kcad`
schema 30).

oneOf.description: Açık ok: the filled triangle's two sides (Open).
Dolu nokta: a filled dot (Dot).
Yok: no arrowhead, the line ends at the tip (None).
Boş üçgen: the triangle's outline (Closed blank).
İnce açık ok: two sides 15° off the line (Open 30).
Dik açık ok: two sides square to each other (Open 90, Right angle).
Küçük nokta (Dot small).
Boş nokta: a ring (Dot blank).
Eğik çizgi: a tick across the tip (Oblique).
Mimari çentik: a heavy tick (Architectural tick).
Dolu kare (Box filled).
Boş kare (Box blank).
Dayanak üçgeni: a filled triangle standing on the tip (Datum triangle filled).

LeaderEntity.description:
A leader (docs/adr/0146): an arrowhead at its first vertex, a line
through its vertices and, with a note, a landing from its last vertex
along the note's direction and the note past the landing's end; one
object. The arrowhead and the landing are measured by the note's height.

arrow.description: The arrowhead; absent: a filled arrow.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's length, times the note's height (docs/adr/0205 §7);
absent: 1. From `MIN_LEADER_ARROW` to `MAX_LEADER_ARROW`.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

height.description:
The note's height, metres, finite and over 0; the arrowhead and the
landing are measured by it.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The note's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
note is drawn, as a text's mask (docs/adr/0145).

pts.description: At least two: the arrow's tip first, where the landing starts last.

rotation.description: The note's and the landing's direction, degrees counter-clockwise from east.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

text.description:
The note, one line; absent: the arrow alone, no landing and no note.
Never empty: no note is the field's absence.

annotation.description:

connections.description: The project's service connections without their secrets (docs/adr/0208 §2).

customCrs.description:
The project's own coordinate system when it is a definition
(docs/adr/0168 §1); `srid` is then 0.

datumTransforms.description: The project's datum choices (docs/adr/0168 §3); none: EPSG's ways.

drawingFont.description: Absent in files written before drawing typefaces (read as Barlow).

drawingUnit.description:
A local project's unit (docs/adr/0165 §2); absent: metres. Only a
project without a coordinate system (SRID 0) has another.

layerStates.description: The project's named layer states (docs/adr/0177 §4), in the menu's order.

secondCustomCrs.description: The second system when it is a definition (instead of `second_srid`).

secondSrid.description:
The project's second coordinate system (docs/adr/0167 §1): its
coordinates are shown beside the project's own; absent: none. Never
the project's own system, never a local project's.

survey.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3);
absent: k = [`REFRACTION`] and no tolerance.

textStyles.description: The project's named text styles (docs/adr/0183 §2), in the order they were made.

topology.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

workspace.description:
The project's type; none while it is not asked (files written before
types). The former Hibrit mode reads as written and means the same
(see [`ProjectSettings::project_type`]).

ProjectStyles.description: The project's own style library (opaque items in v1, see `style`).

affine.description:
`[x₀, a, b, y₀, c, d]`: column i and row j (pixel corners, 0, 0 the
upper left) lie at x = x₀ + a·i + b·j, y = y₀ + c·i + d·j (GDAL's
geotransform order). Invertible.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its file is (embedded); exactly one of
`asset` and `file` is given.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

file.description: The file it shows (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's

object (docs/adr/0139).

srid.description: The file's coordinate system; 0: the file named none and the user took the project's.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges (a COG; docs/adr/0207 §1).

width.description: Its size in pixels.

oneOf.description: Three bands as red, green and blue, a fourth as alpha.
One band in grey.
One band through the file's palette.
One band through a colour ramp.
One band (heights) as a shaded relief.
The ramp darkened by the shaded relief.

RasterResampling.description: How a pixel between samples is shown.

RasterStretch.description: How values are brought to colours (docs/adr/0204 §4).

oneOf.description: As they are (8 bit).
The band's least to its most.
Its 2nd to its 98th percentile.
The style's `min` to `max`.

altitude.description: Its height above the horizon, degrees (0–90).

azimuth.description: Gölgeli kabartma's light: degrees from north, clockwise (0–360).

bands.description: The bands drawn, from 1: three or four for `rgb`, one otherwise.

min.description: `manual`'s least and most value.

nodata.description: The value shown as nothing, in place of the file's.

ramp.description: One of `RASTER_RAMPS`; absent: Gri.

RingGeometry.description: A closed ring in vertex + bulge form (a polygon hole).

zs.description:
Each vertex's elevation, m, as many as `pts`; `null` for a vertex
without one (not 0); absent when no vertex has one (docs/adr/0142).

ScenarioInfo.description:
A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9): its layers are an alternative
kept apart from the field state (Mevcut durum).

ServiceConnection.description:
A connection of the project (docs/adr/0208 §2): what proof requests to
its origin carry, without the secrets.

origin.description: `https://host[:port]`: proof goes to this origin only.

oneOf.description: Tiles by an address template, Web Mercator (TMS with `yFlip`).
OGC API Tiles' map tiles.
An ArcGIS REST MapServer or ImageServer: its cached tiles, else `export`.
Google's Map Tiles API, 2D tiles.
Vector tiles (MVT) by a MapLibre style, a TileJSON or a template.

ServiceLayer.description: A layer drawn from a service (docs/adr/0208 §2).

bbox.description:
The service's extent, WGS 84 degrees (west, south, east, north), as
its capabilities give it: what “Servisin kapsamına yakınlaştır” shows.

connection.description: The project's connection whose proof goes with the requests.

dynamic.description: WMS and `export`: one picture of the view instead of tiles.

grid.description: WMTS's, OGC's and a cached ArcGIS service's matrices.

layers.description: WMS's layer names; WMTS's one layer; ArcGIS's layers shown.

preset.description: The ready basemap it came from.

srid.description: The system asked: WMS's `CRS`, ArcGIS's `imageSR`; a grid's own.

style.description: WMS's and WMTS's style; Google's map type.

template.description: WMTS REST's and OGC's tile template.

tileSize.description: XYZ's and the vector tiles' tile side, pixels; absent 256.

url.description:
XYZ: the template; WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS: the service's address; OGC
API Tiles: the tile set's; vector: the style's, the TileJSON's or the
template; Google: empty.

yFlip.description: TMS: rows counted from the bottom.

ServiceParam.description: A parameter sent with every request (`TIME`, `CQL_FILTER`, …): never a secret.

SplineEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

SurveySettings.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3): the
refraction coefficient k of trigonometric heights, and the greatest
differences a field book's two faces are checked against; the mean
ellipsoidal height of the ground values and whether the survey windows
reduce lengths to the grid (docs/adr/0171); the a priori standard
deviations of a network adjustment (docs/adr/0203 §1). Angles are in
radians, lengths in metres. An absent tolerance is not checked; the
differences are still shown.

faceHz.description: The two faces' horizontal reading difference.

faceSlope.description: The two faces' slope distance difference.

groundHeight.description:
The project's mean ellipsoidal height (m), within [−500, 9000]: the
ground values of Mesafe ölç and Alan hesapla (docs/adr/0171 §2;
schema 16). Points' elevations are not used: whether orthometric or
ellipsoidal is not known.

sigmaCentering.description: Each end's centering, the instrument's and the target's, m (schema 28).

sigmaDirection.description:
A direction's a priori standard deviation, radians (docs/adr/0203 §1;
schema 28); absent: [`SIGMA_DEFAULTS`]'s.

sigmaPpm.description: A distance's part per million of its length (schema 28).

twoWay.description:
A traverse leg's horizontal distance measured from its two ends
(schema 15).

TableAlign.description: A column's alignment; its cells sit in the middle of their rows.

aligns.description: Each column's alignment, as many as there are columns; absent: all left.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

cells.description:
The cells' words, row by row, a row as many as there are columns;
one line each, empty for an empty cell.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

columns.description: Its columns' widths, left to right, metres.

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

frame.description:
Its frame's width, metres: the outline drawn as a band that wide
inside it (Kalın çerçeve); absent: a line as the others.

grid.description: Which of its lines are drawn; absent: all.

header.description: The first row is its heading: bold, centred.

height.description: Its cells' text height, metres.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

merges.description: Merged ranges: each range's words in its top left cell, its others empty.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

rotation.description: Degrees counter-clockwise from east: its rows run along it.

rows.description: Its rows' heights, top to bottom, metres.

source.description: Where its rows came from (Tabloyu güncelle); absent: written by hand.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

TableGrid.description: Which of a table's lines are drawn, when not all.

oneOf.description: Its outline alone.
Its outline and the lines between its rows.
None: the words alone.

TableSource.description: Where a table's rows came from (docs/adr/0184 §5).

oneOf.description: Koordinat çizelgesi: the points and vertices of these objects.
Alan çizelgesi: these areas, their area and perimeter.
Öznitelik tablosu: these objects' attributes.
A CSV or Excel file by its name (and sheet): it is chosen again to update.

TextAlign.description:
Which point of a text its `p` is (docs/adr/0145 §1): horizontally its
left, centre or right; vertically on its baseline, at its bottom (0.2 of
its height under the baseline), its middle (half its height over it) or
its top (its height over it). The left of the baseline, where a text
always stood, is no value but the field's absence: a text has one
spelling.

TextEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

align.description: Where `p` is on the text; absent: the left of the baseline (docs/adr/0145).

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

boxWidth.description:
Metres, finite and over 0: the lines wrap word by word to this width.
Absent: they end only at line breaks.

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

font.description: Its typeface; absent: the project's, in the look of docs/adr/0055.

height.description: Metres.

labelOf.description:
The object whose label this text writes (Etiketleri yazıya çevir's
“Nesneye bağlı”, docs/adr/0175 §4): its persistent id. The text
follows the object as its label at `label_scale`; absent: a text of
its own. Given with `label_scale` or not at all.

labelScale.description: The scale's denominator (1:N) the linked label is written at; finite, over 0.

lineSpacing.description:
The distance between the lines' baselines in 5/3 of the height (DXF's
group 44); absent: 1. From `MIN_LINE_SPACING` to `MAX_LINE_SPACING`.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

mask.description:
The text's box is filled with the drawing area's colour before the
text is drawn (Netcad's “fon”): what lies under it does not show.

oblique.description:
How far its letters lean, degrees, positive with their tops to the
right; within ±`MAX_OBLIQUE`, never 0 (upright is the field's absence).

path.description:
The curve its letters stand on (Eğri boyunca yazı, docs/adr/0196 §1),
in its own frame; absent: a straight text.

runs.description:
The letters' formats: ranges of the text's Unicode scalar values (not
UTF-16 units), in order, not overlapping, each with a format; a run
with no format is not written, and touching runs of one format are one.
Absent: none.

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

textStyle.description: The project's text style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

widthFactor.description:
The letters' width times this, the height kept (Netcad's “sıkışma”,
DXF's group 41); absent: 1. Finite, over 0, at most `MAX_WIDTH_FACTOR`.

TextPath.description:
The curve a text's letters stand on (docs/adr/0196 §1). Its vertices are
in the text's own frame: `p` its start, x along the text's `rotation`, y
square to it on the left, metres. The first vertex is `p` itself and is
not written; `pts` are the ones after it. The frame carries the curve with
the text when it moves, turns or scales.

bulges.description:
Edge i's bulge, from vertex i to vertex i + 1 (vertex 0 is `p`):
DXF's tan(θ/4), counter-clockwise positive; as many as `pts`. Absent:
every edge straight.

pts.description: The vertices after `p`, at least one.

TextRun.description: A range of a text's letters and their format (docs/adr/0182 §1).

color.description: Its own colour, as an object's (`#E5484D`, or a theme name); absent: the text's.

script.description: Raised or lowered, at 0.6 of the height; absent: on the line.

start.description: Its first letter and the one past its last, counting Unicode scalar values.

TextScript.description: A run raised over the line (superscript) or lowered under it (subscript).

fontFile.description: The typeface file a DXF named for it, written back as it came.

height.description: The texts' height on paper, mm; absent: the tool's height.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's text styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description:
Its name: trimmed, one of its kind whatever its letters' case, never
`STANDARD_STYLE`.

oblique.description: As a text's (`TextFace::oblique`).

widthFactor.description: As a text's; absent: 1.

TileGrid.description: A service's tile grid as read: its system and its matrices, coarsest first.

TileMatrix.description:
One matrix of a tile grid (docs/adr/0208 §3): its pixel's size in the
grid system's units, its top left corner as east and north (longitude
and latitude), whatever order the service wrote them in, its tiles' and
its own size in tiles.

TmDefinition.description:
A transverse Mercator grid: its origin's latitude (0 when left out),
central meridian, scale and false origin.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

TopologyException.description:
A finding marked as left on purpose: its rule, its objects' persistent
ids in the finding's order, and its place.

objects.description: At least one.

TopologyRule.description: A rule: its kind on a layer and, between layers, another layer.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's rules; exceptions name it.

layer.description:
The layer's id (a layer, not a group). A rule whose layer the project
no longer has stays and is not checked.

other.description: The other layer's id, for a rule between layers only.

value.description:
The value of a kind that takes one: a length in metres, an angle in
radians; absent: the kind's default.

oneOf.description: Çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap.
Boşluk olmamalı: no gap is closed in among the layer's areas.
İnce alan olmamalı: no part of an area is thinner than the value.
Yinelenmemeli: no edge of a line lies on another line, no point on another point.
Sarkan uç olmamalı: every line end meets the layer's line work.
Kısa kenar olmamalı: no edge is shorter than the value.
Küçük açı olmamalı: no corner is sharper than the value.
Geçerli olmalı: ADR 0201 §6's problems.
Ortak sınırda köşe eksik olmamalı: an area's vertex on a neighbour's edge is the neighbour's too.
… ile çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap the other's.
… içinde kalmalı: the layer's objects stay within the other's areas.
Sınırı … sınırlarında olmalı: the layer's areas' boundaries lie on the other's line work.
… çizgilerinin ucunda olmalı: the layer's points are at the other's line ends.

TopologySettings.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

exceptions.description: Findings marked as left on purpose (docs/adr/0202 §3).

rules.description: The rules, in the order they are checked and listed.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

Workspace.description:
A project's type (`app/workspaces.ts`, docs/adr/0165): CAD or CBS, each
with its own scene, axes and ribbon; every command still runs in both.
`plan3d` and `disaster` are announced ("Yakında") and cannot be chosen yet;
a file naming them shows as CBS. There is no hybrid type any more.

input.description: Input of `project.changes` v1: one atomic commit of object changes and, optionally, metadata.

blocks.description:
Block definitions made, replaced or removed (docs/adr/0144 §5), in
the same commit as the objects: an insert may place a block this
commit makes, and a block may go with the last insert placing it.

versions.description: New version of every created or updated object.

commands.title: Projeyi paylaş

commands.title: Proje oluştur
commands.summary: Bir çalışma alanında (kişisel alan ya da kurum) boş bir bulut projesi açar: adı, ayarları, katman ağacı ve stilleriyle; isteğe bağlı açıklama, tür ve etiketlerle. Proje açanındır; başkaları paylaşımla eklenir. Çalışma alanında project.create hakkı ister (kurumda proje yöneticisi ve üstü); projeye bağlı bir izin istemez. Zarfın tenantId'si çalışma alanıdır, projectId boş kalır. Aynı idempotency anahtarıyla tekrar aynı projeyi verir.

AnnotationHeights.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper, mm (docs/adr/0205 §1): a
height not given is its kind's default.

AuthKind.description: The proof a service asks for (docs/adr/0208 §12).

oneOf.description: `name=value` in the address, one or more.
`Name: value` headers, one or more.
HTTP Basic: a user name and a password.
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
An ArcGIS token from `generateToken`, by a user name and a password.
OAuth 2's client credentials at a token address.
Google's API key and session.

Convention.description:
Which way a Helmert transformation's rotations turn: EPSG's position
vector convention (9606) or its coordinate frame convention (9607).

CrsBase.description:
A local system's base: a projected system of the registry by its EPSG
code (`srid`), or a transverse Mercator the project defines
(`definition`); exactly one.

CrsDefinition.description:
A coordinate system the project defines (docs/adr/0168 §1): its name
and what it is.

CrsPlane.description:
A local system's coordinates to its base's: base x = a·x + b·y + c,
base y = d·x + e·y + f; a similarity turns counter-clockwise (degrees),
scales, then shifts.

CrsSystem.description: The kind of system a definition is.

CustomDatum.description:
A datum the project defines: its ellipsoid and, when it has one, its
seven parameters to WGS 84 (without them it stands alone).

DatumTransform.description:
The project's choice for a pair of the registry's datums instead of
EPSG's way (docs/adr/0168 §3); the pair's other way is its reverse. It
shifts by seven parameters (`helmert`) or an NTv2 grid (`grid`); exactly
one.

name.description: What the values rest on: “ED50 → TUREF: Bölge 7”.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

DimensionStyleDef.description: A named dimension style (docs/adr/0183 §3): sizes in paper mm.

arrowSize.description: The arrowhead's length, mm; absent: the arrowhead's default times the height.

dimLineColor.description: The line fields as a dimension's (docs/adr/0205 §6); weights in paper mm.

height.description: The value's height on paper, mm.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's dimension styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description: As a text style's.

DimensionTextPlace.description: Where a dimension's value stands other than over its line (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: Its middle on the line, the line hidden under it.

DrawingFont.description:
The typeface of the text that is part of the drawing (text objects,
dimension values, labels; `app/appearance.ts` DRAWING_FONTS), bundled with
the app. A project setting: everyone who opens the project sees the same
letters. Files written before it have none (Barlow).

DrawingUnit.description:
The unit a local project's lengths are typed and read in (docs/adr/0165 §2).
Geometry stays in metres: the unit is where the user meets the numbers
(typed and shown lengths, coordinates and areas, DXF's `$INSUNITS`). A
project with a coordinate system has the system's unit.

Ellipsoid.description: An ellipsoid: its name, semi-major axis (m) and inverse flattening.

FeatureFeed.description: Where a layer's objects came from, to take them again (docs/adr/0208 §10).

bbox.description: The area asked, `[x₁, y₁, x₂, y₂]` in the project's system; absent: all.

filter.description: CQL, or ArcGIS's `where`.

key.description: The attribute that matches objects when they are taken again.

name.description: WFS's type, OGC's collection, ArcGIS's layer.

srid.description: The system asked of the service.

FeedKind.description: What a layer's objects were taken from (docs/adr/0208 §10).

oneOf.description: An ArcGIS REST layer's `query`.
A GeoJSON document at an address.

FieldChoice.description:
One value of a field's value list: the code written to the attribute
and the label shown for it.

GeographicDefinition.description: Latitude and longitude on a datum.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

GridChoice.description:
An NTv2 grid the project's datum choice names: its SHA-256 (the
device's grid library keeps it by that), the file's name and size, the
accuracy the project gives it.

size.description: The file's size in bytes (at most the core's 256 MiB).

Helmert.description:
Seven parameters: translations (m), rotations (″) in their convention,
the scale difference (ppm), and the accuracy (m) when it is given.

JunctionLayer.description: A junction layer: its points' role and, optionally, which of them it takes and which are closed.

closed.description: An expression: the junctions it holds for (a closed valve) are passed by no analysis.

oneOf.description: Bağlantı: splits the edges it lies on.
Kaynak: where the supply comes from (Yalıtım's beslemesiz kalan).
Vana: where Yalıtım stops.

LabelStyle.description: How entity labels on a layer are drawn; sizes in CSS px.

LayerField.description: A field of a layer (docs/adr/0199 §1): its name is the attribute's key.

alias.description: The name the table and the form show.

default.description: The value a new object takes, in its canonical text.

max.description: A number's greatest value, in its canonical text; included.

min.description: A number's least value, in its canonical text; included.

required.description: An object may not leave it empty; written only as `true`.

scale.description: A decimal's most fraction digits (0–15).

values.description: The values a text or a number takes, when only some.

LayerFilter.description:
A layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): an object passes when the condition
holds for it and, when there is a list, the list names it.

expression.description:
The condition (İfadeyle seç's language, docs/adr/0100): an object
passes when it is true.

objects.description:
Only these objects, by their persistent ids (Seçimden süzgeç); an id
the drawing does not hold is not wrong.

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a group or a layer.

feed.description:
Where the layer's objects were taken from, to take them again
(docs/adr/0208 §10). Only a layer has it, never a group.

fields.description:
A layer's fields (docs/adr/0199 §1): the schema of its objects'
attributes, in the order the table and the form show them; empty, no
schema (and nothing written). Only a layer has them, never a group.

filter.description:
The layer's filter (docs/adr/0211 §2): only the objects that pass it
are shown, picked and given to its tools. Only a layer has it, never a
group or a layer drawn from a service.

replaces.description: A scenario's layer: the base layer it stands for (docs/adr/0210 §9).

scenario.description: A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9). Only a group has it.

service.description:
A layer drawn from a map service (docs/adr/0208 §2): it holds no
objects. Only a layer has it, never a group.

snap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): off, or only some kinds;
absent, the general kinds. Only a layer has it, never a group.

time.description:
A temporal layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): which attributes
hold its objects' start and end. Only a layer has it, never a group.

LayerSnap.description:
A layer's own snapping (docs/adr/0163 §4): `{ "off": true }`, no
snapping to its objects; or `{ "kinds": [...] }`, only these kinds (as
far as the general kinds take them). Exactly one of the two, and a list
that is not empty: the readers refuse anything else ([`LayerSnap::problem`]).

off.description: No snapping to the layer's objects; written only as `true`.

LayerState.description:
A named layer state (docs/adr/0177 §4; QGIS's map themes, AutoCAD's
layer states): the tree's nodes as they were when it was saved, their
visibility and, when it was saved with them, their locks and the layers'
styles. The project keeps them (`ProjectSettings::layer_states`).

id.description: One of its kind among the project's states.

name.description:
Its name as the menu lists it: not empty, one of its kind (as written,
spaces at its ends aside).

nodes.description: The nodes, in the tree's order when it was saved.

LayerStateNode.description: A node of a layer state: a layer's or a group's id and what was kept of it.

locked.description: Its own lock, when the state keeps locks.

node.description: The node's id; a node the tree no longer has is passed over.

style.description: A layer's style, when the state keeps styles; a group has none.

LayerStyle.description: A layer's look. `renderer` (the style engine, docs/STYLE.md) is opaque JSON in v1.

color.description: Hex colour or a theme token (fg, fg-dim, ink, paper).

lineWeight.description: Plot line weight in mm.

LayerTime.description:
A layer's time setting (docs/adr/0210 §2): its objects' start (or
moment) and end are the values of these attributes.

cumulative.description: Birikimli: an object shows from its start on, whatever its end; written only as `true`.

end.description: The attribute holding the end; absent, the objects are moments.

key.description: The attribute naming an object across its versions (Zamanı karşılaştır's key).

start.description: The attribute holding the start (an instant layer's moment).

LocalDefinition.description: A local system: its base and the plane transform from it to the base.

oneOf.description: Uçlarda: at their ends, and an end on another edge splits it there.
Köşelerde: at every vertex too.

field.description: The attribute it reads: a speed in km/h, or the whole edge's cost.

speed.description: A speed cost's speed (km/h) where the field gives none it can read.

unit.description: A field cost's unit (“TL”, “dk”); a speed cost's is minutes and names none.

oneOf.description: Süre, minutes: the length over the speed.
The field's value for the whole edge, shared by its pieces by their lengths.

closed.description: An expression: the edges it holds for are out of service, travelled by nothing.

costs.description: The costs besides the length, in the order the tools offer them.

edges.description: The line layers whose lines, paths and arcs are the edges, in this order.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; one of its kind in the project.

junctions.description: The point layers whose points are junctions, sources or valves.

name.description: Trimmed; one of its kind in the project.

oneOf.description: Every edge both ways.
Every edge the way it is drawn (pipes drawn with the flow).

By an attribute's value: `forward` the way the edge is drawn only, `backward` against it only, `closed`
neither; any other value, and none, both ways.

NetworkKind.description: Yol ağı or Şebeke: what the tools offer first; the graph is the same.

NetworkLayer.description: An edge layer and, optionally, which of its objects are edges.

filter.description: An expression: only the objects it holds for; absent: all of them.

layer.description: The layer's id. A layer the project no longer has is said when the network is built.

ProjectSettings.description: Project settings (`ProjectSettingsData`): saved with the drawing, the same for everyone who opens it.

annotation.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper (docs/adr/0205 §1); absent:
every kind's default.

connections.description: The project's service connections without their secrets (docs/adr/0208 §2).

customCrs.description:
The project's own coordinate system when it is a definition
(docs/adr/0168 §1); `srid` is then 0.

datumTransforms.description: The project's datum choices (docs/adr/0168 §3); none: EPSG's ways.

drawingFont.description: Absent in files written before drawing typefaces (read as Barlow).

drawingUnit.description:
A local project's unit (docs/adr/0165 §2); absent: metres. Only a
project without a coordinate system (SRID 0) has another.

layerStates.description: The project's named layer states (docs/adr/0177 §4), in the menu's order.

secondCustomCrs.description: The second system when it is a definition (instead of `second_srid`).

secondSrid.description:
The project's second coordinate system (docs/adr/0167 §1): its
coordinates are shown beside the project's own; absent: none. Never
the project's own system, never a local project's.

survey.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3);
absent: k = [`REFRACTION`] and no tolerance.

textStyles.description: The project's named text styles (docs/adr/0183 §2), in the order they were made.

topology.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

workspace.description:
The project's type; none while it is not asked (files written before
types). The former Hibrit mode reads as written and means the same
(see [`ProjectSettings::project_type`]).

ProjectStorage.description:
Where a cloud project keeps its content (TODOS.md §12.1, CLOUD-21).
File projects (binary `.kcad` revisions) and references to an outside
PostGIS come as their own kinds.

oneOf.description:
Object by object in the server's PostGIS database (managed): every
save is one transaction and the others see it at once.

As a file: a sequence of immutable, verified `.kcad` v2 revisions in
the server's object store (docs/adr/0031); each save is a new
revision, based on the one it replaces.

ProjectStyles.description: The project's own style library (opaque items in v1, see `style`).

ProjectType.description: What kind of work a project is (TODOS.md CLOUD-02). A label only (see the module notes).

oneOf.description: General CAD work; also every project made before types existed.
GIS work.
A land readjustment under article 18 of the Zoning Law (18 uygulaması).
A zoning plan (imar planı).
Dividing and merging parcels (ifraz and tevhit).
Road design.
Architecture.

ScenarioInfo.description:
A group made a scenario (docs/adr/0210 §9): its layers are an alternative
kept apart from the field state (Mevcut durum).

ServiceConnection.description:
A connection of the project (docs/adr/0208 §2): what proof requests to
its origin carry, without the secrets.

origin.description: `https://host[:port]`: proof goes to this origin only.

oneOf.description: Tiles by an address template, Web Mercator (TMS with `yFlip`).
OGC API Tiles' map tiles.
An ArcGIS REST MapServer or ImageServer: its cached tiles, else `export`.
Google's Map Tiles API, 2D tiles.
Vector tiles (MVT) by a MapLibre style, a TileJSON or a template.

ServiceLayer.description: A layer drawn from a service (docs/adr/0208 §2).

bbox.description:
The service's extent, WGS 84 degrees (west, south, east, north), as
its capabilities give it: what “Servisin kapsamına yakınlaştır” shows.

connection.description: The project's connection whose proof goes with the requests.

dynamic.description: WMS and `export`: one picture of the view instead of tiles.

grid.description: WMTS's, OGC's and a cached ArcGIS service's matrices.

layers.description: WMS's layer names; WMTS's one layer; ArcGIS's layers shown.

preset.description: The ready basemap it came from.

srid.description: The system asked: WMS's `CRS`, ArcGIS's `imageSR`; a grid's own.

style.description: WMS's and WMTS's style; Google's map type.

template.description: WMTS REST's and OGC's tile template.

tileSize.description: XYZ's and the vector tiles' tile side, pixels; absent 256.

url.description:
XYZ: the template; WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS: the service's address; OGC
API Tiles: the tile set's; vector: the style's, the TileJSON's or the
template; Google: empty.

yFlip.description: TMS: rows counted from the bottom.

ServiceParam.description: A parameter sent with every request (`TIME`, `CQL_FILTER`, …): never a secret.

SurveySettings.description:
The project's survey constants and tolerances (docs/adr/0169 §3): the
refraction coefficient k of trigonometric heights, and the greatest
differences a field book's two faces are checked against; the mean
ellipsoidal height of the ground values and whether the survey windows
reduce lengths to the grid (docs/adr/0171); the a priori standard
deviations of a network adjustment (docs/adr/0203 §1). Angles are in
radians, lengths in metres. An absent tolerance is not checked; the
differences are still shown.

faceHz.description: The two faces' horizontal reading difference.

faceSlope.description: The two faces' slope distance difference.

groundHeight.description:
The project's mean ellipsoidal height (m), within [−500, 9000]: the
ground values of Mesafe ölç and Alan hesapla (docs/adr/0171 §2;
schema 16). Points' elevations are not used: whether orthometric or
ellipsoidal is not known.

sigmaCentering.description: Each end's centering, the instrument's and the target's, m (schema 28).

sigmaDirection.description:
A direction's a priori standard deviation, radians (docs/adr/0203 §1;
schema 28); absent: [`SIGMA_DEFAULTS`]'s.

sigmaPpm.description: A distance's part per million of its length (schema 28).

twoWay.description:
A traverse leg's horizontal distance measured from its two ends
(schema 15).

fontFile.description: The typeface file a DXF named for it, written back as it came.

height.description: The texts' height on paper, mm; absent: the tool's height.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's text styles (a UUIDv7).

name.description:
Its name: trimmed, one of its kind whatever its letters' case, never
`STANDARD_STYLE`.

oblique.description: As a text's (`TextFace::oblique`).

widthFactor.description: As a text's; absent: 1.

TileGrid.description: A service's tile grid as read: its system and its matrices, coarsest first.

TileMatrix.description:
One matrix of a tile grid (docs/adr/0208 §3): its pixel's size in the
grid system's units, its top left corner as east and north (longitude
and latitude), whatever order the service wrote them in, its tiles' and
its own size in tiles.

TmDefinition.description:
A transverse Mercator grid: its origin's latitude (0 when left out),
central meridian, scale and false origin.

customDatum.description: the project's own (exactly one of the two).

datum.description: The registry's datum by name; or

TopologyException.description:
A finding marked as left on purpose: its rule, its objects' persistent
ids in the finding's order, and its place.

objects.description: At least one.

TopologyRule.description: A rule: its kind on a layer and, between layers, another layer.

id.description: One of its kind among the project's rules; exceptions name it.

layer.description:
The layer's id (a layer, not a group). A rule whose layer the project
no longer has stays and is not checked.

other.description: The other layer's id, for a rule between layers only.

value.description:
The value of a kind that takes one: a length in metres, an angle in
radians; absent: the kind's default.

oneOf.description: Çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap.
Boşluk olmamalı: no gap is closed in among the layer's areas.
İnce alan olmamalı: no part of an area is thinner than the value.
Yinelenmemeli: no edge of a line lies on another line, no point on another point.
Sarkan uç olmamalı: every line end meets the layer's line work.
Kısa kenar olmamalı: no edge is shorter than the value.
Küçük açı olmamalı: no corner is sharper than the value.
Geçerli olmalı: ADR 0201 §6's problems.
Ortak sınırda köşe eksik olmamalı: an area's vertex on a neighbour's edge is the neighbour's too.
… ile çakışmamalı: the layer's areas do not overlap the other's.
… içinde kalmalı: the layer's objects stay within the other's areas.
Sınırı … sınırlarında olmalı: the layer's areas' boundaries lie on the other's line work.
… çizgilerinin ucunda olmalı: the layer's points are at the other's line ends.

TopologySettings.description: The project's topology rules, tolerance and exceptions (docs/adr/0202 §1).

exceptions.description: Findings marked as left on purpose (docs/adr/0202 §3).

rules.description: The rules, in the order they are checked and listed.

Vec2.description: A point in world units: x = east (Y, sağa), y = north (X, yukarı).

Workspace.description:
A project's type (`app/workspaces.ts`, docs/adr/0165): CAD or CBS, each
with its own scene, axes and ribbon; every command still runs in both.
`plan3d` and `disaster` are announced ("Yakında") and cannot be chosen yet;
a file naming them shows as CBS. There is no hybrid type any more.

input.description: `POST /v1/tenants/{tenant}/projects`: a new project's metadata (its objects follow as commands).

storage.description:
How the project is kept, for good (docs/adr/0031); absent: object by
object in PostGIS (`database`). A `file` project gets its content
from its first committed revision.

input.title: ProjectCreate

AccessSource.description: Where a person's role in a project comes from.

oneOf.description: They own it.
It was shared with them.
The organisation's policy lets its owners and admins into projects not shared with them.

AnnotationHeights.description:
The project's annotation heights on paper, mm (docs/adr/0205 §1): a
height not given is its kind's default.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

AreaPart.description:
A part of a multi-part area past its first (docs/adr/0143): its outer
ring in vertex + bulge form, its holes and its vertices' elevations, as
the area's own fields hold the first part's. A multi-part polyline's
part is the same, open and without holes (docs/adr/0174).

zs.description: Each vertex's elevation, as the area's own `zs` (docs/adr/0142).

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute an insert shows as text (docs/adr/0144 §7): the insert's
attribute `tag`, else `value`, written at `p` in the definition's
coordinates, moved with the insert.

align.description: Where `p` is on the text, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

height.description: Metres, in the definition's size.

prompt.description: What Blok ekle asks for it.

rotation.description: Degrees, counter-clockwise from east, as a text's.

widthFactor.description: The letters' width times this, as a text's (docs/adr/0145).

AuthKind.description: The proof a service asks for (docs/adr/0208 §12).

oneOf.description: `name=value` in the address, one or more.
`Name: value` headers, one or more.
HTTP Basic: a user name and a password.
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
An ArcGIS token from `generateToken`, by a user name and a password.
OAuth 2's client credentials at a token address.
Google's API key and session.

BlockDefinition.description:
A block definition (docs/adr/0144): objects drawn once, placed many
times. Its objects' ids are local to it; their layer is kept, but an
insert draws them on its own layer (the DXF's layer 0), each with its own
colour or line weight when it has one.

attributes.description: The texts an insert shows from its attributes (ATTDEF).

base.description: The point placed at an insert's `p`, in the definition's coordinates.

name.description: Unique in the drawing, Turkish case folded.

BlockRecord.description: One stored block definition (docs/adr/0144 §5) and its version.

CellRange.description: A merged range: `rows` × `cols` cells from row `row`, column `col`.

CircleEntity.description:
Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

oneOf.description: The file's colours.
ASPRS's classes, each its colour.
Heights through a ramp.
Intensity in grey.
Single, first, intermediate and last returns in four colours.
The object's colour.

asset.description:
The project library's asset its bytes are (embedded); exactly one of
`asset`, `file` and `url` is given.

bounds.description: `[x₁, y₁, z₁, x₂, y₂, z₂]`, as its header says.

count.description: Its points, as its header says.

file.description: The file (linked): absolute, or relative to the drawing's folder.

url.description: An HTTP or HTTPS address read by ranges.

ConstructionEntity.description: Construction line or ray: base point and unit direction.

attrs.description: GIS attributes; text in v1 (typed attributes: CLAUDE.md §15).

color.description: Colour override; absent = the layer's colour ("katmana göre").

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an
object (docs/adr/0139).

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.

Convention.description:
Which way a Helmert transformation's rotations turn: EPSG's position
vector convention (9606) or its coordinate frame convention (9607).

CrsBase.description:
A local system's base: a projected system of the registry by its EPSG
code (`srid`), or a transverse Mercator the project defines
(`definition`); exactly one.

CrsDefinition.description:
A coordinate system the project defines (docs/adr/0168 §1): its name
and what it is.

CrsPlane.description:
A local system's coordinates to its base's: base x = a·x + b·y + c,
base y = d·x + e·y + f; a similarity turns counter-clockwise (degrees),
scales, then shifts.

CrsSystem.description: The kind of system a definition is.

CustomDatum.description:
A datum the project defines: its ellipsoid and, when it has one, its
seven parameters to WGS 84 (without them it stands alone).

DatumTransform.description:
The project's choice for a pair of the registry's datums instead of
EPSG's way (docs/adr/0168 §3); the pair's other way is its reverse. It
shifts by seven parameters (`helmert`) or an NTv2 grid (`grid`); exactly
one.

name.description: What the values rest on: “ED50 → TUREF: Bölge 7”.

DimensionArrow.description:
A dimension's arrowheads other than the oblique tick, which is no value but
the field's absence (docs/adr/0183 §3).

oneOf.description: A filled triangle, its tip on the dimension line's end (Dolu ok).
The triangle's two sides (Açık ok).
A filled circle about the end (Nokta).
Nothing at the ends (Yok).

Fields every object has. `id` is the object's local id inside a v1 file.
v1 keeps no persistent id: it is derived from the file's content when the
file is opened (`identity`, docs/adr/0014); the server's is a UUID in
PostgreSQL (`feature.id`).

angle.description: Linear: measured direction in degrees (0 = ΔY, 90 = ΔX).

arrow.description: Its arrowheads; absent: oblique ticks.

arrowSize.description:
The arrowhead's (or tick's) length; absent: `DEFAULT_TICK` for ticks,

the line starts from (docs/adr/0147).

dimLineType.description: The dimension line's type; absent: continuous.

dimLineWeight.description: The dimension line's weight, paper mm as an object's; absent: a hairline.

dimStyle.description: The project's dimension style it follows, by its id; absent: Standart.

extBeyond.description: How far the extension lines pass the dimension line; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_BEYOND`.

extLineType.description: The extension lines' type; absent: continuous.

extOffset.description: The extension lines' gap from the measured points; absent: `DEFAULT_EXT_OFFSET`.

extWeight.description: The extension lines' weight, paper mm; absent: a hairline.

font.description: The value's typeface; absent: the project's.

lineWeight.description:
Its own line weight, paper millimetres as the layer's
(`LayerStyle.line_weight`), 0 the thinnest line; absent = the layer's
("katmana göre"). What a DXF's group 370 and an NCZ's pen give an

mask.description:
The value is drawn over the drawing's background (docs/adr/0147, as a

symbol.description: Library symbol overriding the layer's style.
